checks.description: A unique H10-sized MMC below the exact H616 eMMC controller is admitted independent of mmc_host numbering using sysfs metadata only.
Absent, wrong-type/controller, undersized/oversized, malformed-capacity and ambiguous targets are rejected by tests.
The read-only diagnostic consumes the reusable helper without behavior regression; the helper opens no block node and no writer enters the production SD image.
Focused and existing SD/NFS tests, documentation checks and feature-workflow validation pass with physical identity and write limitations clearly stated.

constraints.text: For this measured test profile, require exactly 61,079,552 sectors. Do not carry forward the current 60–64 million-sector heuristic as write-target admission; a different module capacity requires an explicit reviewed profile value.

Fail closed when any additional MMC card or malformed/unreadable MMC candidate appears below the selected controller, even if one valid-capacity candidate exists. Test malformed numbers, trailing junk, overflow and ambiguous inventory; unrelated SD cards must remain ignored.

Keep the helper limited to sysfs metadata and the existing read-only diagnostic. Preserve diagnostic output and behavior, add no block-node open or writer to the helper or production SD image, and do not treat its returned path as sufficient identity for a later write.

Document that H10 has no CID evidence and that offline fixture success does not prove installed-module identity, data preservation, rollback or physical write safety. H12 remains the separate hardware gate.

decision.rationale: H10 physically observed one MMC under the exact 4022000.mmc controller at 61,079,552 sectors, while the independently verified QEMU writer targets only a synthetic USB disk. Factoring the existing read-only locator provides a useful, bounded improvement: before, discovery is embedded in init.c and tested only for host numbering and two in-range candidates; after, a reusable helper can reject malformed and ambiguous inventory offline. Decision 0018 and H12 still require a separately reviewed image, exact physical target, recovery path and authorization before any eMMC write. H10 recorded no CID, so controller/type/capacity alone cannot establish unique module identity or physical write safety. The helper adds negligible runtime/storage cost and no required dependency.

tasks.title: Factor and test read-only H616 eMMC target admission
